purpose: Full automated UI checkpoint for both backends, with regressions repaired and rerun on matching isolated binaries

build_input_snapshot.method: Committed archive/staging/bootstrap inputs plus explicit UI/native routing/test fixture overrides; concurrent root network-policy edits excluded.

verification.python_scope: Includes two concurrent overlay/staging tests excluded from the UI commit.

scope.reason_for_different_backend_counts: The dedicated 30-case Metal fixture always selects rust-metal and is excluded from the Views control run; every common fixture runs with both backends.
scope.skip_reason: Four opt-in performance scenarios, the real-user Arc import and the interactive one-hour manual harness were not activated. Chromium launcher reports these GTest skips as SUCCESS; counts here normalize explicit SKIPPED lines.

intermediate_full_repeat.note: Before final main-window Cocoa routing and settings-reopen test correction; not the final acceptance result.

repairs: Sidebar row identity is allocated on WorkspaceWebView lifetime, independently of WebContents. Preparing UI state no longer creates dormant pages or bypasses PreparePage service attachment; restored lazy tabs and page services are tested in both backends.

Metal form canvases observe native host-widget visibility and combine it with View visibility. Hidden windows cancel armed input/menu/prefix state, hide surfaces and reject stale user activation; reopening schedules a fresh update. This covers appearance/action/checkbox/selector/paragraph/folder/notice surfaces.
Emoji ContentsChanged waits until native IME composition finishes before persisting/normalizing the value, preserving the in-progress composition.
Folder/notice error accessibility nodes have alert roles before dispatching kAlert, avoiding native AX platform crashes while preserving complete body/error names and default Cancel.

The native Cocoa routing adapter forwards plain keydown/keyup for the main standalone workspace window as well as panels through NSWindow responder dispatch. Main command equivalents retain AppKit menu handling; panel equivalents retain explicit dispatch. Native keypress and matching renderer keyup are checked after workspace chords.

Preconnect/upload/media fixtures explicitly seed their two-profile/two-workspace configuration, instead of depending on production onboarding defaults. Their temporary profiles, fake picker/media/permission services and real UI workflows are retained.

UI tests synchronize committed navigation before replacing document titles/inspecting HTTP menus, reopen settings after workspace/confirmation actions close them, wait for real native focus/key release and accept completed Metal transitions without demanding obsolete native snapshot layers.

Paragraph test diagnostics recognize a complete wrapped logical value only when all shaped line fragments are in that surface submitted scene. No physical presentation or typography claim is inferred from that diagnostic.

isolation.browser_profiles: Temporary user-data-dir allocated by Chromium test launcher/fixtures
isolation.media_fixture: Synthetic devices/audio and test permission cache/picker overrides
isolation.cleanup: Removed only the known root/leaf fixture files created under the relative chosen/ directory by the initial failed upload setup; successful fixture runs use ScopedTempDir.

limits: This accepts the current automated UI suite, not full Rust ownership or elimination of Views. Native editing, container/event/focus/accessibility adapters and major settings/service surfaces still require migration.
Native calls and synthetic composition do not substitute for manual IME candidate/VoiceOver, unusual scale/theme/RTL, prolonged interaction and the final signed app/session checkpoint.
Metal API validation was enabled for Metal runs. Test durations and submitted-scene diagnostics are not CPU/GPU/actual drawable-presentation benchmarks and establish no performance gain.

The normal app/profile and real Arc import/manual one-hour/performance opt-ins were not exercised. Historical headless reports remain historical; this artifact supersedes their deferred automated matrix for matching current sources.
